=== GLOBAL STANDARDS (L1) ===
principles:
  typescript:
    strict_mode: true
    target: ES2022
    no_any: "Avoid `any` — use `unknown` with type guards or explicit generics"
    async_first: "All DB calls, LLM calls, and I/O are async — always await"

  error_handling:
    pattern: "AppError class hierarchy with immutable HTTP status codes"
    subclasses: [ValidationError 400, AuthError 401, ForbiddenError 403, NotFoundError 404, ConflictError 409, UnprocessableError 422]
    serialization: "{ error: string, code?: string, details?: Record<string, unknown> }"
    rule: "Throw from route handlers; centralized errorHandler middleware catches and serializes"

  database:
    driver: "pg Pool (async, connection pooling)"
    helpers: "query<T>() returns T[], queryOne<T>() returns T|undefined, execute() returns { rowCount }"
    placeholders: "$1, $2, ... (numbered, NOT positional ?)"
    transactions: "transaction<T>(fn) wraps in BEGIN/COMMIT/ROLLBACK"
    migrations: "SQL files in pg-migrations/, timestamp prefix YYYYMMDDHHMMSS for new files, tracked in schema_migrations"
    slow_query_logging: "Queries > 500ms logged with sanitized params"

  validation:
    library: zod
    pattern: "Middleware factories — validateBody(schema), validateQuery(schema), validateParams(schema)"
    method: "safeParse (not .parse() which throws)"
    response: "{ error: firstIssueMessage, details: zodError.issues }"

  llm:
    return_type: "ChatResult { text: string, usage: { inputTokens, outputTokens } }"
    rule: "Always use .text accessor — never treat ChatResult as a string"
    providers: "Multi-provider routing via model registry — claude-cli, anthropic, openai-compat, openrouter"

  api_design:
    documentation: "JSDoc @swagger annotations on every route → auto-generated OpenAPI spec"
    pagination: "{ items: T[], total: number, hasMore: boolean, cursor?: string }"
    response_shape: "Success: res.json(data). Error: { error, code, details } via AppError"
    middleware_chain: "validateBody(schema) → authRequired → async handler"
    security_headers: "helmet (CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options, noSniff, referrerPolicy)"
    caching: "Cache-Control: no-store on all responses, etag: false"

  testing:
    backend: "Jest with ts-jest, serial (maxWorkers: 1), 30s timeout, PG_POOL_SIZE=1"
    frontend: "Vitest with jsdom, globals: true"
    rule: "Always clean up DB pool connections in afterAll()"

  code_style:
    no_over_engineering: "Only make changes that are directly requested or clearly necessary"
    no_premature_abstraction: "Three similar lines > premature helper function"
    minimal_containers: "Don't add docstrings, comments, or type annotations to code you didn't change"
    security_first: "Never commit .env files, API keys, or secrets. Use vault for sensitive values."

=== PROJECT CONTEXT (L3) ===
name: rorca
type: web-app
purpose: AI spec orchestration platform that converts plain-English briefs into structured user story specs and autonomously executes them story-by-story via isolated agent subprocesses (claude, opencode, or codex)

stack:
  - React 18
  - TypeScript 5.7 (strict)
  - Vite 5
  - Tailwind CSS 3
  - xterm.js (@xterm/xterm)
  - react-router-dom 7
  - framer-motion
  - recharts
  - Express.js
  - PostgreSQL 16 (pg pool, pgvector, Apache AGE)
  - pg-boss (job queue)
  - Node.js >= 20
  - tsx (TypeScript runner)
  - Jest (backend tests)
  - Vitest (frontend tests)
  - Playwright (E2E)

key_modules:
  - src/panels/ — 5 primary UI panels (Specs, Runs, Analytics, Direction, Settings)
  - src/components/ — shared UI (Sidebar, RunTerminal, CommandPalette, slide-overs)
  - src/contexts/ — WorkspaceContext, AuthContext, ThemeContext, ToastContext
  - backend/src/routes/ — 32 Express route files
  - backend/src/lib/ — core services (sse-hub, direction-stack, llm-client, execution-engine, context-router, workspace-echolocation, rate-limiter, scheduler)
  - backend/src/worker.ts — pg-boss worker process (pipeline job consumer)
  - backend/src/lib/execution-engine.ts — sole execution engine for all agent types
  - backend/src/db/ — PostgreSQL pool, migration runner, 70+ migrations
  - backend/src/mcp/ — MCP stdio server (24 tools)
  - forge/ — spec JSON files, run-loop.sh bash fallback, self-register script

constraints:
  - Migrations must use timestamp format YYYYMMDDHHMMSS for new files (sequential 001-079 already exist)
  - Worker process must be running for pipeline triggers to execute
  - AGE search_path must be restored after every graph query
  - Auth middleware is globally disabled (intentional, local tool)
  - CLAUDE_BIN full path required for child process spawning (NVM PATH not inherited)
  - spec id is always the filename slug, never the human title

deployment_target: local (self-hosted, npm run dev) or Docker Compose

ports:
  frontend: 5210
  backend: 3030
  finops_sim: 5200

integrations:
  - claude CLI (claude --print)
  - opencode CLI (opencode run)
  - codex CLI (codex --approval-mode auto-edit)
  - GitHub OAuth + webhooks
  - Linear (post-launch)
  - Vercel (post-launch)
  - Slack (post-launch)
  - Stripe billing

=== SPEC BRIEF (L4) ===
Build a rich, unified model + engine + thinking control picker directly in the spec detail slide-over screen (SpecDetailSlideOver.tsx). This replaces the simple dropdown added in TriggerPopover with a full-featured model selection experience visible on the spec stories tab.

## Problem Context

Currently:
- Engine (claude/opencode/codex) is set globally via RORCA_AGENT env var — can't switch per-spec
- Model override is a simple select dropdown in TriggerPopover — hidden behind "Run in Pipeline" click
- No thinking/effort controls — Claude supports extended thinking and effort levels but execution-engine.ts doesn't wire them
- The existing rich model picker in Settings > Providers (with search, cost tiers, context window) isn't reusable from the spec screen
- Users want to pick "Claude Opus with high thinking" for architecture specs and "Haiku via OpenRouter" for simple CRUD specs — from the same screen

## What to Build

### 1. Spec-Level Engine + Model Picker (visible on spec detail screen)

Add a unified spec-level control bar at the top of the Stories tab in SpecDetailSlideOver. This bar should have:

**Engine selector** (segmented control / pill toggle):
- Three options: Claude (Sub) | OpenCode (API) | Codex (Sub)
- Shows which engines are available (green dot = installed/configured, grey = not available)
- Selecting an engine filters the model list to only show models available for that engine
- Claude engine: shows Claude subscription models only (opus, sonnet, haiku) — no per-token cost
- OpenCode engine: shows all API models (Anthropic API, OpenRouter, Google, OpenAI, Ollama) — shows per-token cost
- Codex engine: shows "ChatGPT subscription model" (no model choice)
- Default: whatever RORCA_AGENT is currently set to
- Persists to spec JSON as agentOverride field

**Model selector** (rich picker, NOT a plain select):
- Opens as a popover/dropdown anchored to the model button
- Groups: Recommended (starred), then by provider (Anthropic, OpenRouter, Ollama, etc.)
- Each row shows: model label, speed tier icon, context window, cost/1K tokens
- Search/filter at top
- Selected model highlighted with checkmark
- When Claude engine selected: only show claude-opus-4-6, claude-sonnet-4-6, claude-haiku-4-5
- When OpenCode engine selected: show all 350+ models from GET /api/direction/models
- When Codex engine selected: model picker is disabled with tooltip
- Persists to spec JSON model field via existing PUT /api/specs/:specId

**Thinking controls** (only visible when Claude engine + Opus/Sonnet selected):
- Effort level: segmented control with Low | Medium | High
- Extended thinking toggle: on/off switch
- Thinking budget: slider (only visible when extended thinking is on) — 1K, 5K, 10K, 25K, 50K
- Greyed out for non-Claude engines and Haiku
- Persists to spec JSON as: thinkingEnabled, thinkingBudget, effortLevel

### 2. Backend: Wire Engine Override + Thinking Controls Through Pipeline

**spec JSON schema extension**:
- agentOverride: "claude" | "opencode" | "codex"
- thinkingEnabled: boolean
- thinkingBudget: number
- effortLevel: "low" | "medium" | "high"

**POST /api/pipeline/trigger** — already accepts modelOverride and agentOverride in PipelineTriggerSchema. Wire them:
- agentOverride overrides RORCA_AGENT for this run only, passed to worker then execution-engine as --agent flag
- Add thinkingEnabled, thinkingBudget, effortLevel to PipelineTriggerSchema
- Pass through pg-boss job payload to worker to execution-engine CLI flags

**execution-engine.ts** — new CLI flags:
- --thinking (boolean, enables extended thinking)
- --thinking-budget N (max thinking tokens)
- --effort low|medium|high
- spawnClaude() passes these to claude --print
- spawnOpenCode() and spawnCodex() ignore thinking flags

**pg-boss-schemas.ts** — extend PipelineRunJobPayload with new fields

**worker.ts** — pass new fields from job payload to execution-engine CLI args

### 3. PUT /api/specs/:specId — extend to accept new fields

Already handles model. Extend to persist agentOverride, thinkingEnabled, thinkingBudget, effortLevel.

### 4. Story Badge Updates

When spec-level model changes via the new picker, all story ModelBadge components should immediately reflect it. Per-story overrides still work. Auto-assign All still works.

### 5. Visual Design

Control bar feels like a cockpit — compact but information-dense. Engine pills on left, model button center, thinking controls right. ~48px collapsed, ~120px with thinking expanded. Dark theme compatible. Virtualize the 350+ model list for performance.
